tactical_thesis: Give the southern route a blocking Melantha supported by Steward and Hibiscus. Retire Fang after four DP cycles to fund Midnight's northern support. Popukar intercepts officers upstream of waiting civilians, receives Ansel's extended-range healing, and hands off to fresh Cardigan before paired pressure. Keep both exit defenses and assign Castle-3 dedicated roadblock clearance after hostile exhaustion.
